original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹扬比奥-坦布拉公路车辆遭袭，一名儿童死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹西赤道州扬比奥-坦布拉公路沿线两辆汽车遭袭击并被纵火，造成一名约八岁儿童死亡、两名成人受伤。坦布拉县专员称袭击据称由苏丹人民解放军反对派（SPLA-IO）武装实施，但SPLA-IO尚未公开回应。警方表示正在调查，尚无嫌疑人被捕。

location.raw_text: along the Yambio-Tambura road near Mabia, about 14 km from Tambura, Western Equatoria State, South Sudan

key_facts.fact: 两辆汽车在扬比奥-坦布拉公路遭袭击并被纵火，一名儿童死亡、两名成人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A child was killed and two other people injured when two vehicles were attacked and set ablaze along the Yambio-Tambura road in South Sudan’s Western Equatoria State on Sunday

key_facts.fact: 事件发生在距坦布拉约14公里的马比亚附近，时间约为下午4时
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the incident occurred near Mabia, about 14 km from Tambura, at around 4 p.m. as the vehicles were travelling towards Tambura

key_facts.fact: 坦布拉县专员称车辆据称遭苏丹人民解放军反对派（SPLA-IO）武装袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Mupaya said the vehicles were allegedly attacked by forces of the Sudan People’s Liberation Army in Opposition (SPLA-IO)

key_facts.fact: 警方正在调查，尚无嫌疑人被捕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: police were investigating the killing and the burning of the two vehicles ... He said no suspects had been arrested

key_facts.fact: SPLA-IO尚未公开回应上述指控
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The SPLA-IO had not publicly commented on the allegations.

uncertainties: 袭击实施方为SPLA-IO的说法仅为县专员指控，SPLA-IO尚未回应，未获独立证实
死亡儿童身份尚未确认
尚无嫌疑人被捕，事件具体情况仍在调查中
目前仅单一来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，缺乏交叉验证
